text: There was no warning and no hearing. Just a knock at the door, and an instruction: pack a bag, and get out. The family had been charged with nothing.
provenance: There was no warning. There was no hearing. There was a knock at the door, and an instruction that sounds impossible for a home someone actually owns: pack a bag, and get out.
And the family who owned it had never been charged with anything at all.

text: For about a week they slept on a relative's couch, made homeless in their own city, while the government held the deed to their home.
provenance: For about a week, they slept on a relative's couch — a family made homeless in their own city, while the government held the deed to their home like a hostage.

text: Then the city let them back in, on one condition. The father had to sign an agreement barring his own son from the house.
provenance: They were finally allowed back inside on a single condition. Christos had to sign an agreement promising to bar his own son from the house.

text: To get their home back, these parents had to give up their son at the door. It could just as easily have been your address, not because you did anything, but because someone under your roof did.
provenance: Read that again. To get their home back, these parents had to give up their son at the door.

text: They kept the house. They did not drop the class action for everyone still facing that knock.
provenance: The Sourovelises got their own home free within about a year — the city quietly dropped its case against their house, and they kept it.
